messages:
Nadia (Payments): Zenith LLC just pinged AP asking whether to submit a W-8 or W-9 for invoice 33021, and they called out a gross-up clause in the SOW. Can tax/legal advise so we don't release incorrectly.

Zenith LLC: Hi Redwood, Zenith here. We're a US-formed LLC but >50% owned by a UK parent. Which IRS form should we upload? Our SOW (attached in portal) includes: "Client to gross-up payments to cover any withholding tax". Link: https://billing.zenith.co/inv/33021

Omar AP: Tagging @Priya (Tax) and @Legal (Contracts). AP will not process invoice without tax form. No TIN on PDF, putting invoice on hold.

Priya (Tax): Quick guideliners: If they're a US tax resident (EIN and taxed in US) -> W-9. If they claim foreign status -> W-8BEN-E + supporting residency docs. Foreign ownership alone doesn't change US tax classification for an LLC.

Legal (Contracts): On gross-up: default is NO gross-up unless Legal + Commercial explicitly approved it. If the SOW was countersigned as-is, we need to check who signed and whether that clause was approved. Send us the executed page.

Nadia (Payments): Placed hold on invoice 33021. AP note: "Awaiting W-9 w/ EIN or valid W-8BEN-E + Legal confirmation on gross-up. Do not pay."

invoice-bot: Invoice 33021 status -> ON_HOLD. Reason: missing tax form and contract clause review.

Zenith LLC: Uploaded W-9 and provided EIN 11-2223334. Attached the executed SOW page with gross-up clause. Please confirm receipt.

Priya (Tax): Received W-9 in portal. I'll validate EIN/TIN match and update tax classification. If W-9 checks out, treat as US payee and no withholding. If they later provide W-8, we'll reassess.

Priya (Tax): EIN validated via TIN check. Tax classification: US payee. From tax perspective, no withholding required. Gross-up is a commercial obligation, not a tax requirement.

Legal (Contracts): I reviewed the attached SOW. Clause is present and the SOW bears signatures. I do not see evidence of Commercial approval for the gross-up. Escalating to Commercial to confirm whether we honor it or require amendment. For now, AP should not pay based solely on that clause.

Omar AP: Hold remains. AP note updated: "W-9 validated; Legal escalated gross-up to Commercial. Awaiting Commercial decision."

Zenith LLC: Understood. We'll wait for your update. If you need a contract amendment/redline we can engage our procurement.

Priya (Tax): Marked vendor as US payee in the vendor master. No tax withholding will be applied if payment is released.

Nadia (Payments): Closing admin loop: AP will release payment once Commercial confirms stance on gross-up. Tax/Legal action items done. invoice-bot: keep invoice ON_HOLD until Commercial decision posted.

invoice-bot: Last update: W-9 validated, pending Commercial decision on SOW gross-up clause. Invoice 33021 remains ON_HOLD.
